description:
Developed by HippocrAstro, a team of undergraduates multidisciplinary team from Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS)

Meet the Team — HippocrAstro

ALEXANDER BRIAN NYAWAI NGIAN — Founder & CEO (Malaysia): Product + mission lead. Owns roadmap, regulatory compliance strategy, partner outreach, and the overall pitch/story for HippocrAstro.

MUHAMMAD NAWAWI BIN ZAKARIA — Machine Learning and Web Dev with Data Integrations (Malaysia): Builds and deploys the ML models and Clinical AI workflows powering AstroVital, develops the desktop/WebGL interface, and pipes biometric telemetry and orbital sensor outputs into visual charts.

GAN ALVIN — Business Partner (Malaysia): Leads customer discovery with space operators and healthcare providers, go-to-market strategies, and international stakeholder engagement.

MOHAMMAD ATIQ ZUHAILI BIN AZIZ — Researcher (Malaysia): Conducts literature reviews, evaluates space-biological research datasets, and drives R&D for biomedical and aerospace applications.

MUHAMMAD IL’YASA ZULKARNAIN BIN MARZUKI — Creative Design (Malaysia): Designs visual assets, branding materials, UI/UX layouts, and presentation decks to communicate the HippocrAstro mission clearly.

HANSON GARI — Audit (Malaysia): Designs internal controls, reporting packs, and leads the independent audit workflow backing our medical and aerospace compliance promise.
